fusions.name: Gap in the Weave
fusions.desc: A thrown pin that deals 40 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Stitch Run
fusions.desc: Looses 4 pins at once, spread apart, each dealing 5 damage. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Threaded Gap
fusions.desc: Darts 5 tiles forward, and your movement speed rises by 20% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Fine Print
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 10%, and your armour by 5%.
